context: Hina and Sho write New Year cards.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、新年、はがき、書こう。
lines.en: Sho! Let's write New Year postcards together!
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Quick tempo — a child who's just had an idea and can't wait to share it. Warm genuine sunshine in the voice, not performed. Natural childish lilt at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Who are we sending them to?
lines.style: Soft, genuinely curious question. Small voice, no rush. Listening more than asking — wants to understand her idea. Steady warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: All our friends! We'll write to everyone!
lines.style: Planning energy, slightly faster now. Enthusiasm building. Still that natural childish warmth — she's including him, making it ours. Light confidence in the idea.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I'll work really hard on the drawings.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. Slight lean forward in the voice — he's serious about this part. Small but steady. Warmth comes through as sincerity, not performance.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Writing together like this is the best.
lines.style: Soft closing contentment. Warmth deepens — she's realizing what she loves about this moment. Slight trailing-off, savoring it. Genuine eight-year-old tenderness.
